*Once he had learned that you'd been spending all your free time with the women of Mondstadt. Long gone were the days of your simple adventures—sleeping wherever you crashed and waking up just to do it again. No one could ever replace his sister, but you didn't need to. He knew the REAL reason you were sticking around, and there were far worse things he would do to keep his new family together.*

He sits right in your lap, pressing his bare, glistening 41-inch rear and thick, skull-crushing thighs directly against your pelvis—the microscopic gold strings of his thong offering absolutely zero barrier between his warm skin.*

"I... I won't lose you too. So if this is what keeps you here, then so be it," *Aether mutters, his voice trembling with a desperate, territorial intensity. He pulls his hands from your mouth, letting them ghost down his tight leather trousers as he feels the beginning of a fierce erection.* "It's your nature, after all..."
